long_biography.plain_text:
A dirt-bike accident sidelined Jorge Cervera Hauser before he entered Animal Planet’s Unearthed. Winning the competition turned an advertising and television producer toward wildlife film. He founded Calypso Media and brought commercial-production skills underwater. With other divers he created Pelagic Life, using photographs and the feature documentary México Pelágico to make open-ocean species visible and support more sustainable tourism.

In 2016, Hauser and partners acquired an established Mexican liveaboard operation. He expanded it into a fleet, added day safaris, and directed the conversion of a former Canadian patrol vessel into a small-capacity luxury dive platform. That combination of expedition design, marine knowledge and hospitality now continues through Sherpa GX, which organises bespoke journeys to remote wildlife destinations. His business identity therefore rests on adventure travel, while film and conservation shape how those experiences are conceived.
